Autofolio is the digital folder for your car, motorbike or trailer. All deadlines, documents and info in one place – with reminders right on time.

INSPECTION CALCULATED AUTOMATICALLY
Enter the first registration – Autofolio calculates the Austrian §57a inspection ("Pickerl"), including the grace period and the new rule from 19 May 2027. For vehicles registered in Germany, the HU is calculated.

ALL DEADLINES AT A GLANCE
Vignette, insurance, service, tyre change, cancellation periods: Autofolio shows what's due next and reminds you with a notification.

DIGITAL FOLDER

SERVICE LOG

LOGBOOK
Start and end trips with one tap. Mileage allowance is calculated automatically, export as PDF or CSV.

EMERGENCY

ON THE ROAD
Remember your parking spot with a parking meter, digital vignettes, toll boxes and country info with travel checklists for Croatia, Slovenia, Italy and Germany.

PRIVATE

FREE OR PRO

No liability – the punched inspection sticker or the inspection report always prevails.

name: Blokvia: Block Puzzle
description:
Blokvia is a calm, fast and rewarding block puzzle game. Drag colourful blocks onto a 10x10 board, clear full rows and columns, and chain combos for big scores. Free to play and made for quick breaks.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag one of the three pieces at the bottom onto the board.
• Fill a row or column to blast it away.
• Clear several lines at once for combo bonuses and streaks.
• The game ends when no piece fits, so plan ahead.

4 GAME MODES

• Route: 100 levels across 5 worlds. Every level has its own board and goal: clear lines, reach a score, clear one colour or chain combos. Earn up to 3 stars.
• Time Attack: 2 minutes on the clock, every cleared line adds 3 seconds.
• Daily Challenge: a new starting board every day, the same for everyone.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT
• Fair pieces: while the board has room, every set of three can be played out. No rigged dead ends.
• Always fresh: 39 piece shapes and a different starting board in every level.
• Daily missions, a daily streak, 17 achievements and unlockable themes (Night Route, Sunset, Forest, Neon).
• Glossy visuals, satisfying clear effects and calm music. Sound, music and haptics have their own switches.
• Works offline. No account needed. Your progress stays on your device.
• 10 languages, chosen automatically from your device: English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Russian, Arabic, Indonesian and Japanese.

Blokvia is free and supported by ads: one small banner and occasional full-screen ads at natural breaks.

Questions or ideas? Write to byaltun4@gmail.com. Developed by dev/ByAltun.

name: CaseUnison
description:
Plan display-case part replacements with a clear view of the work, the time and the parts on your staging shelf.

CaseUnison helps model display studios, collectors and enclosure maintenance teams compare separate replacement jobs with tasks that share the same access. Follow each physical state from the original installation through replacement and final restoration, all on your iPhone.

YOUR WORKFLOW

1. Build your case
Create installation slots and identify original parts, replacements, handling units and fastener groups. Keep physical objects separate from the positions they occupy. Start with your own case or explore the clearly labeled synthetic example.

2. Confirm the rules
Enter removal and installation conditions independently, along with complete action times, inspection requirements and sources. Define conditions that must all be met, or alternative access paths. Unknown times and unconfirmed rules remain drafts for review.

3. Set the replacement tasks
Choose the target slots and specified new parts. Record retention restrictions, required actions, optional start times and deadlines. Distinguish a checked replacement from a restored case that has passed its checkpoint.

4. Group and compare
Arrange tasks into access groups and preview a proposed move before saving it. Compare active time, waiting time, loosening and tightening operations, repeated removals and staging peaks. Separate processing restores the case between groups while keeping replacements already installed. Shared steps come from the resulting states, rather than matching action names.

5. Rehearse the sequence
Move through one action at a time. Inspect the before and after states, prerequisites, duration, fastener changes and tasks served. Link the parts frame or structure list with the operation ticket, sequence charts and staging shelf. Keep return parts, removed originals and new parts awaiting installation distinct. Jump to peak staging and inspect why an access part needs to be removed again.

6. Try another arrangement
Explore different timings, task groups, deadlines and count limits in a separate trial. Save a useful trial as its own case while preserving the original records. Compare feasible candidates without relying on an unexplained combined score.

7. Record and restore
Freeze a plan snapshot before actual work. Confirm the real object, start and finish times, physical locations, fastener states and inspections. Add notes and an optional photo. Unsubmitted drafts do not record work; corrections add events and preserve history. Replan remaining work from the actual recorded state, then review replacements, returned parts, tightening, inspections and old-part destinations before finishing.

LOCAL RECORDS THAT KEEP THEIR CONTEXT

Save case drafts, rules, sources, task groups, plan snapshots, physical locations and execution history on your device. Earlier plans retain their rule versions. Share an operation sheet or execution summary when you choose; planning and rehearsal happen inside the app.

Built for one operator working serially. No account, connected equipment, server or online AI service is required. The interface is English; your names and notes retain their original text.

PLANNING BOUNDARIES

Results depend on the rules you enter. Search is bounded and does not guarantee a global optimum. CaseUnison does not validate collisions, physical support, tool clearance, material strength, staging area or load capacity. Count limits describe your counting policy. The included example is software validation data, not physical maintenance instructions.

name: CordReprise
description:
Pick up your macrame project with a plan for the cord you have left.

CordReprise helps cord artists, teachers and workshop makers estimate how an unfinished piece can continue. Follow each physical cord, see which end reaches a limit first, and compare changes before weaving the next section.

A workflow built around your current woven edge

1. Measure your starting point
Create a project, label each free cord end and enter its current length. Confirm the left-to-right order and set individual fringe goals. Each end keeps its own identity, measurements and target as it moves through the work.

2. Build your own sample library
Record a complete knot group, swap or finishing action. Enter the role and consumption at each input position, then specify the output order. Add finished advance, material, tension notes and a photo when available. Revisions create new versions so earlier plans retain their original sample snapshots.

3. Arrange the continuation
Choose samples, bind input positions and set whole repeat counts. Keep required segments locked and define allowed stopping and swap points. Set minimum repeats, fringe requirements and a target range for added finished length.

4. Try a change on the rope route
Trace a cord through every later step. Inspect a knot group's roles, use and remaining lengths. Try a different swap position or save a candidate with fewer repeats or revised fringe goals. Preview a candidate on the route and compare each end against the current plan, including changes in finished advance.

5. Check the remaining length
Read free length, fringe targets and the balance beyond each target. Material shortfalls, working-tail requirements and fringe deficits are shown separately. Review complete workable units and the last allowed stopping point that retains your fringe goals.

Explore a future-consumption pressure scenario to see how extra modeled use affects the plan. Starting measurements, fringe targets and recorded finished advance retain their values.

6. Weave, measure and continue
Record the complete units you actually finished, confirm the observed cord order and enter fresh free lengths. Compare these measurements with the earlier prediction, then save a new checkpoint. The remaining plan starts from that checkpoint. Prior measurements and plan versions stay available in history.

Keep the project close to the work

Projects, samples, photos, drafts, candidates and measurement history are stored on your device. Use the numbered route and continuation summary when you choose to share a plan. VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, a route list and button alternatives support different ways of working.

Forecasts follow your measurements and recorded sample assumptions. Missing consumption or output mappings remain flagged for review. Finished-length estimates appear when the relevant sample advance has been recorded. The included example uses clearly labeled synthetic verification data.

Available in English and Simplified Chinese. No account or internet connection is required for planning.

name: Ebbawyn
description:
Ebbawyn helps you choose where to hang a bird feeder or set a bath, so the birds you invite stay safe.

Two rules come up at every birding club meeting. First, keep feeders either closer than 1 metre to a window or farther than 10 metres from it. In between, a bird leaving the feeder has just enough speed to hurt itself on the glass. Second, keep feeders out of leaping range of fences, branches and roof edges, or the squirrels will have the seed before the chickadees do. Ebbawyn turns both rules into shapes on your own lawn.

WINDOW STRIKE ZONES
Mark both ends of each window. The ground between 1 and 10 metres is shaded and hatched, the close band by the glass is lit, and every feeder marker shows a clear good or move verdict with its distance to the nearest pane.

SQUIRREL LEAP REACH
Add the perches squirrels use: fence tops, tree branches, roof edges, deck rails and posts. Each one gets a ring showing how far a squirrel can leap. Edit the distance if yours are more athletic. Low feeders without a baffle are flagged too, and one tap finds the nearest safe spot.

FEEDER TYPES AND SEEDS
The Larder covers tube, hopper, platform, suet, nyjer, nectar and window feeders, plus three kinds of bath, with the foods that suit each one and the birds that tend to visit. Search by bird or by food.

CARE ROTA
Add refill, scrub, fresh water and sweep jobs for each feeder and bath. Tick them off and the rota counts the days to the next one.

SIGHTINGS NOTEBOOK
Type in any bird you see and how many. The notebook tidies names and adds up counts per species.

AR OR THE YARD SKETCH
The AR view needs an iPhone with an A9 chip or later. The yard sketch works on every phone and does all the same jobs on a simple top-down map. Load the sample garden to try it in a minute.

YOUR NOTEBOOK, YOUR CHOICE
Everything works without an account, and as a guest none of your data leaves your phone. An optional free membership backs up your yards and syncs them between your phones. The camera feed is never recorded or uploaded.

Ebbawyn gives general backyard birding guidance from the measurements you mark. It is not a survey and does not certify anything.

From field notes to the specimen cabinet, EntomoLedger keeps the details of your collection connected.

EVENTS & CALENDAR

• The theme recolours the card, envelope and workspace
• Month calendar of all your events, plus search, sort and filter by type
• Live countdown to the day

GUESTS & RSVPs
• Add guests with groups, reply status, plus-ones, dietary needs and contact details
• Search and filter by reply or group; change a reply in one tap
• Reply chart with headcount including plus-ones

INVITATIONS
• Compose the wording, host line and dress code on an animated invitation card
• Share the invitation as an image or as text, and track who it was sent to

BUDGET & EXPENSES
• Set a total budget and plan by category
• Log expenses with paid / due status; bars show planned against spent, with over-budget warnings
• Export expenses as CSV

TASKS & CHECKLISTS
• Ready-made checklists for each event type with due dates counted back from the event
• Optional task reminders on the due date

SEATING
• Round tables drawn on a floor plan; drag tables to arrange the room
• Drag guests onto tables (or tap a guest, then a table) with automatic capacity checks that count plus-ones

VENUES, PHOTOS & NOTES
• Compare venues with capacity, cost and contacts; call, email or open the address in Maps; mark one as booked
• Keep a photo collection for each event from your library or camera
• Notes for speeches, ideas and supplier details, with pinning and search

REMINDERS & EXPORTS
• Event reminders a week, two days, a day or hours before
• PDF event report, guest list CSV, expenses CSV and a full JSON export

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR DATA
• Sign up with your name, email and password — no social logins
• Works offline: everything is saved on your iPhone first, and changes sync to your private cloud account area when you're back online
• Sign in on another iPhone and your events come with you
• Edit your name, change your password, sign out or permanently delete your account and its data from Settings
• No ads and no tracking

Light and dark appearance, with VoiceOver labels on every control.

name: Finora
description:
# Finora — Financial News and Market Insights

**Finora** is a news reading application focused on global financial news, market dynamics, economic data, and financial event tracking. It is committed to providing users with a clear, efficient, and professional financial information reading experience.

Whether it's global economic policies, market changes, technological industry development, or important corporate news, Finora helps users quickly understand financial hotspots, trace the development of events, and discover key information behind the news.

### Core Functions

**Global Financial News** Aggregates financial reports from multiple fields, including macroeconomics, global markets, technology industries, energy, and corporate news. Through clear content categorization and a simple reading interface, it helps users efficiently obtain financial information of interest.

**Market Dynamics Monitoring** Provides major market indicators, historical trends, and related financial news, supporting categorized browsing, indicator tracking, and data querying, making market changes more intuitive and understandable.

**Financial Special Research** Organizes relevant news, development timelines, and related economic data around important financial events, helping users understand the background of the event, key developments, and information changes at different stages.

**Multi-Source News Comparison** Supports viewing reports from different sources on the same financial event, comparing publication time, main content, and related data, facilitating in-depth reading and information organization.

**Personalized Theme Focus** Follow topics based on your personal interests, such as macroeconomic policies, technology industries, global trade, energy markets, and corporate news. Centralize your viewing of related reports and event updates, reducing time spent repeatedly searching for information.

**Financial Clippings and Reading Notes** Collect valuable news articles, create your own clipping folders, add tags and personal notes, and organize important information into an easily accessible personal financial database.

### More Features

- Categorized reading and keyword search for financial news

- Daily financial news highlights and key events overview

- Global market indicators and historical data query

- Financial topic timelines and related reports

- Comparison of information from multiple sources and viewing data origins

- Customize your watchlist and keywords

- News collection, clipping categorization, and reading notes

- Reading history and local data management

- Simple and comfortable reading interface

- Supports light and dark display modes

- No account registration required; personal records are saved locally on your device

Finora focuses not only on the news itself but also on the connections between information. Through news reading, event tracking, data observation, and personal knowledge organization, it makes financial information more organized, helping users build their own financial reading and research space.

**Finora — Understand the Story Behind the Market.**

Starting with the news, see the complete picture of financial events.

*Disclaimer: Finora provides financial information display and organization tools and does not constitute any investment advice or provide securities trading services.*

name: Foldvik
description:
Το Foldvik είναι ένα προσεγμένο οριγκάμι-σύντροφος για περίεργους αρχάριους και έμπειρους καλλιτέχνες του χαρτιού. Μάθε κλασικά μοντέλα με καθαρή καθοδήγηση βήμα προς βήμα, ακολούθησε επιμελημένες διαδρομές μάθησης και κράτησε ιδιωτικό ημερολόγιο για όσα δημιουργείς.

23 ΜΟΝΤΕΛΑ ΜΕ ΠΡΟΣΕΓΜΕΝΕΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ
Από μια βάρκα πέντε λεπτών και μια φιλική αλεπού-μαριονέτα μέχρι λουλούδι λωτού, κύκνο και προχωρημένο χάρτινο δράκο. Κάθε μοντέλο περιλαμβάνει εικονογραφημένα στάδια διπλώματος, ρεαλιστικό χρόνο, χρήσιμες σημειώσεις για τις τσακίσεις και πλήρη λίστα υλικών.

ΜΙΑ ΠΡΑΚΤΙΚΗ, ΟΧΙ ΜΙΑ ΠΑΡΑΣΤΑΣΗ
Το Foldvik δεν έχει κλειδωμένα μαθήματα, μηχανισμούς πίεσης ή θορυβώδεις ανταμοιβές. Εξερεύνησε ανά δυσκολία, θέμα ή διάθεση και ακολούθησε μια διαδρομή όταν θέλεις κατεύθυνση. Η απαλή προβολή προόδου δείχνει τον χρόνο και τις δεξιότητες που χτίζεις, χωρίς να μετατρέπει το χόμπι σε άλλη δουλειά.

ΔΙΠΛΩΣΕ ΜΕ ΤΟΝ ΔΙΚΟ ΣΟΥ ΡΥΘΜΟ
Ακολούθησε καθοδηγούμενες συνεδρίες με τον δικό σου ρυθμό. Κάνε παύση όποτε χρειάζεται, άνοιξε μια συμβουλή και ολοκλήρωσε με μια καταχώριση στο ημερολόγιο. Προτιμάς να πειραματιστείς; Το χρονόμετρο Ελεύθερου Διπλώματος σου δίνει ήσυχο χρόνο με το χαρτί, χωρίς οδηγίες.

ΚΡΑΤΗΣΕ ΤΙΣ ΑΝΑΜΝΗΣΕΙΣ ΠΟΥ ΜΕΤΡΑΝΕ
Πρόσθεσε φωτογραφία της ολοκληρωμένης πτύχωσης, διάθεση και λίγες λέξεις στο ιδιωτικό σου ημερολόγιο. Επισκέψου ξανά όσα έφτιαξες, τι δυσκόλεψε και τι σε εξέπληξε. Οι φωτογραφίες και οι σημειώσεις μένουν στο iPhone σου.

ΣΧΕΔΙΑΣΜΕΝΟ ΓΙΑ ΗΣΥΧΑ ΧΕΡΙΑ

name: Führerscheinakademie
description:
Die Führerscheinakademie bereitet dich auf die Theorieprüfung vor und lässt dich die Situationen danach selbst fahren. Du lernst für Deutschland, Österreich, die Schweiz, Liechtenstein, Luxemburg oder Ostbelgien, für Motorrad, Pkw, Anhänger, Traktor, Lkw oder Bus.

UNTERRICHT PRO LAND UND KLASSE
Wähle Land und Führerscheinklasse. Die App zeigt dir genau die Kapitel, die für deinen Kurs gelten: über 1.200 Lektionen in 95 Kombinationen aus Land und Klasse, gegliedert nach den amtlichen Unterrichtseinheiten. Jede Lektion erklärt die Regel, zeigt einen Fall aus dem Verkehr und endet mit einem Merksatz und passenden Übungen. Schaubilder und Fotos zeigen, worauf es ankommt.

UNTERRICHT, DER DIR VORGELESEN WIRD
„Unterricht starten“ führt dich Schritt für Schritt durch eine Lektion: Einstieg, Regel, Schaubild, Fall, Merksatz, dann die Übungen. Auf Wunsch liest dir die App jeden Schritt vor. Am Ende jeder Unterrichtseinheit steht eine Lernkontrolle, bestanden ab 80 Prozent.

ÜBEN MIT SOFORTIGER RÜCKMELDUNG
Über 13.900 Übungsfragen mit Erklärung. Nach jeder Antwort siehst du in Grün, was richtig ist, und in Rot, was nicht stimmt. Geübt wird im Antwortformat deines Landes: In Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz und Liechtenstein können mehrere Antworten richtig sein, in Luxemburg und Ostbelgien genau eine. Falsche Antworten kommen wieder, bis sie sitzen.

PRÜFUNG SIMULIEREN
Die Prüfungssimulation richtet sich nach der veröffentlichten Fragenzahl und Bewertung deines Landes, zum Beispiel Fehlerpunkte in Deutschland oder 80 Prozent je Modul in Österreich. Am Ende siehst du, ob du bestanden hättest und welche Fragen du wiederholen solltest.

JEDEN TAG EIN PAKET
Das Tagespaket stellt dir jeden Tag eine Runde aus neuen Aufgaben und Wiederholungen zusammen. Die Statistik zeigt deinen Lernstand, deine Prüfungsreife und die Tage bis zu deinem Prüfungstermin.

SELBST FAHREN
Im 3D-Fahrsimulator lenkst, gibst Gas und bremst du selbst, mit dem Fahrzeug deiner Klasse. Mehr als 30 Fahrszenen, je nach Fahrzeugart 15 bis 21 davon: Starkregen, ein Ball zwischen parkenden Autos, ein Bahnübergang, Abbiegen mit dem Lkw oder die Schleppkurve mit dem Anhänger. Am Ende wertet die App Tempo, Reaktion, Bremsweg und Abstand aus.

FILMFRAGEN AUS DEM SIMULATOR
Ein kurzer Film hält im entscheidenden Moment an, dann kommt die Frage. Du siehst sofort, ob du richtig lagst, und kommst von dort in die passende Lektion. Je Land und Fahrzeug sind es 17 bis 20 Filmfragen. Es sind eigene Aufgaben, keine amtlichen Prüfungsfilme.

VERKEHRSZEICHEN OFFLINE
1.061 Verkehrszeichen, Tafeln und Markierungen der sechs Länder, mit Bedeutung und Verweis auf die passenden Lektionen.

DEINE DATEN BLEIBEN BEI DIR
Kein Konto, kein Tracking, keine Werbung. Dein Lernstand wird nur auf deinem Gerät gespeichert.

KOSTENLOS STARTEN, EINMAL ZAHLEN
Frei sind die erste Lektion jedes Kapitels mit allen Übungen, alle Verkehrszeichen und die Fahrszene Starkregen. Den übrigen Inhalt schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo:
• Vollzugang: alle Länder, Motorrad, Pkw, Anhänger und Traktor.
• Profi-Zugang: alle Länder und alle Klassen, zusätzlich Lkw und Bus.
Die App bietet dir den Kauf an, der zu der Klasse passt, die du gerade lernst.

ZUSATZKURS FÜR BERUFSFAHRER
Für die Klassen C1 bis DE gibt es den Zusatzkurs „Berufskraftfahrer-Qualifikation (Code 95)“, in der Schweiz und in Liechtenstein „Fähigkeitsausweis (CZV)“. Er bereitet auf die Kenntnisbereiche vor und ist keine anerkannte Aus- oder Weiterbildung; er ersetzt weder einen Kurs noch eine Prüfung und kommt in der Prüfungssimulation nicht vor.

HINWEIS
Die Übungsfragen sind eigene Fragen der Führerscheinakademie. Die amtlichen Prüfungsfragen sind nicht enthalten. Die App ersetzt weder die Fahrschule noch die Prüfung.

name: Game Alert: Steam Play Alerts
description:
“Just one more match…” Find out when that match actually starts.
Game Alert sends an emergency-style alert when your partner starts and stops a Steam game.

· GAME ALERT — Elden Ring started
· ESCALATED — 2 hours in, entering “one more match” territory
· ALL CLEAR — done after 2h 40m · now is a good time to ask

■ Your partner connects
Send a link and your partner taps “Sign in through Steam”. It is Steam’s official sign-in page, so we never see a password. They can disconnect at any time.

■ Weekly play stats
Total hours, time per day, top game, longest session and latest night — compared with last week and shareable as an image.

■ Only the alerts you want
Turn start, escalation and end on or off. Escalate after 1 to 4 hours.

■ Light
No sign-up. Records are deleted automatically after 100 days, and you can delete everything in settings.

Note: the app screens are in Korean. Steam “Game details” must be public. Status is checked about every 2 minutes.
Game Alert is not affiliated with Valve Corporation. Steam is a trademark of Valve Corporation.

name: Gently Held
description:
Keep track of your child’s daily care and the moments you want to remember. Gently Held brings activity logs, family organization and a photo journal together in Arabic and English.

Log feedings, pumping, sleep, diaper changes and growth measurements. Use timers for breastfeeding and sleep, and look back through the activity timeline when you need a record.

Organize appointments, reminders, caregiving tasks, checklists and shopping. Create separate profiles for children and pregnancies so you can find the records for each one.

Save photos, notes and milestones. Choose the dates and entries for a PDF memory book in Arabic or English, or create a report from the records you select.

Everyday tools work offline and without an account. Your family records are stored on your device. You decide when to export, create an encrypted backup or share a file.

Use the trackers to organize your information. For diagnosis or treatment, consult a qualified healthcare professional.

name: GHZQ
description:
Glad you picked this app—your notes keep helping us refine what comes next.

This is a calm paper practice desk for daily exposure limits and framed names on this iPhone.

A quote list without a size limit is easy to overdo, even on paper. You get Iris for today’s exposure, Frame for a short watchlist, Contact for lots and fills, and Darkroom for settings and Privacy. It is a personal on-device simulation only—no broker and no real funds.

YOUR DESK, AT A GLANCE
- Iris: remaining exposure before you click a paper ticket

- Contact: lots, fills, and a reset when you want a clean sheet
- Darkroom: shutter, grain, favorites, Privacy, Terms, and wipe

PRACTICE IN SECONDS

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

name: GobyTune
description:
GobyTune ile piyano ve nota öğrenmeye adım adım, keyifle başla! Sevimli rehberin Goby, notaları tanımaktan canlı solfeje, sağ ve sol el pratiğinden iki elle çalmaya kadar her aşamada yanında.
GOBYTUNE NASIL ÇALIŞIR?
Her eser, öğrenmeyi kolaylaştıran 4 yapılandırılmış çalışma adımından oluşur:
1. Keşif ve Solfej
- Eserin notalarını Sol Anahtarı üzerinde incele, her notaya dokunarak gerçekçi piyano sesini dinle.
- Ayarlanabilir tempo sürgüsü (BPM) ile diziyi kendi hızında dinle.
- Canlı Solfej modunda mikrofonu aç, notaları sesinle söyle; Goby sesini anlık dinleyip doğru perdede olduğunda bir sonraki notaya geçsin.
2. Sağ El Odaklı Pratik
- Sol Anahtarı üzerinde nota başlarının altındaki parmak numaralarıyla doğru parmak pozisyonunu öğren.
- İster ekran üzerindeki piyano klavyesinden ister mikrofonu açarak kendi gerçek piyanondan çal.
3. Sol El Odaklı Pratik
- Fa Anahtarı portesi ve Do3–Do4 klavyesi ile sol elini rahatça ısındır ve ritmi koruyarak çal.
4. İki El Birlikte (Çift Porte)
- Sol ve Fa anahtarını aynı zaman ekseninde görerek iki elini birleştir.
- Çoklu dokunma destekli iki oktavlı ekran klavyesi veya kendi gerçek piyanonla eşzamanlı akor ve melodi pratiği yap.
ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLER
• Gerçekçi Piyano Sesi: Cihaz içi sentez ile anında, gecikmesiz akustik piyano sesi.
• Canlı Mikrofon Algılama: Hem solfej hem gerçek piyano çalarken sesleri cihazında yerel olarak tanır.
• Çalışma Yolu ve İlerleme Takibi: Tamamladığın her adımda XP ve elmas kazan, günlük serini büyüt.
• Günlük Hatırlatıcı: Her gün saat 17:00 civarında Goby’nin hatırlatmasıyla serini koru (Ayarlar’dan açıp kapatabilirsin).
• Türkçe ve İngilizce Dil Desteği: Ayarlar menüsünden tek dokunuşla dil değiştir.
• Üyelik Gerektirmez: İlerlemen doğrudan cihazında güvenle saklanır, hemen pratiğe başlayabilirsin.
Hemen GobyTune’u indir, Goby ile günde birkaç dakika pratik yaparak ilk melodilerini çalmaya başla!

name: GraniteVelocity
description: GraniteVelocity is a welding parameter recorder for arc current, voltage, wire feed, shielding gas, heat input and bead geometry. Keep each pass inside a stable heat window so the joint fuses fully without porosity or cold cracks.

name: Halimere
description:
Halimere finds where acoustic panels belong in your room.

The old way is the mirror trick: you sit in the listening seat while a friend slides a mirror along the side wall, and wherever you can see a tweeter in the glass, that is a first-reflection point. It works, but you need a helper, a mirror and patience. Halimere does the geometry for you.

STEREO TRIANGLE CHECK
Place the two speakers and your seat. You get the speaker spacing, the distance from each speaker to you, the angle at your seat, the toe-in for each speaker and how far the layout is from a true equilateral triangle. Snap seat moves the chair to the spot that closes the triangle.

FIRST-REFLECTION SOLVER
For the left wall, right wall, ceiling and rear wall, Halimere mirrors your seat in the surface and finds exactly where each speaker's sound bounces on its way to your ears. Each point shows its height, how late it arrives and how much quieter it is. A suggested panel area covers both speakers' points with a margin for head movement, snapped to standard 120 x 60 cm panels.

ROOM MODES AND BASS TRAPS
Axial modes are listed from the room's length, width and height, with pile-ups and gaps called out. Corners are ranked for bass traps, best first.

TREATMENT PLAN
Panel count, how much of the walls and ceiling the plan covers, and an order list in the order to hang things.

SAVED ROOMS WITH LISTENING NOTES
Keep every room with before and after notes and a simple clarity score, so you can hear whether the panels made a difference. Search, rename, duplicate and delete with undo.

AR OR PLANNER
In AR, drop marks on the floor and tap the walls; panels appear on your real walls at true size. AR needs an iPhone with an A9 chip or later. The top-down planner works on every device: drag the speakers and seat, set the room size, and every tool gives the same answers. A sample room is one tap away.

ACCOUNT IS OPTIONAL
Everything works without an account, and guest rooms never leave your phone. If you want sync and backup between phones, create a free account with an email and password. You can delete it any time inside the app.

The camera feed is never recorded or uploaded. Halimere gives guidance from basic acoustics; it is not a measurement of your room. Trust your ears for the final word.

name: Haraka App
description:
حركة هو تطبيق السائقين المرتبط بنظام إدارة الحركة والمركبات في شركتك. يجمع كل ما يحتاجه السائق في رحلته في مكان واحد: من طلب السيارة، إلى استلامها، إلى تتبع المسار، حتى انتهاء الرحلة.

تطبيق واحد لشركتك
أدخل رابط خادم الشركة أو امسح رمز QR، ثم سجّل الدخول بحسابك نفسه في النظام. لا تحتاج إلى تسجيل جديد، وبياناتك تبقى على خادم جهتك.

رحلاتك أمامك
• رحلتك القادمة في أعلى الشاشة: السيارة ورقم اللوحة وموعد المغادرة والعودة.
• قائمة برحلاتك القادمة والمنتهية مع حالة كل طلب.
• مراحل واضحة لكل رحلة: جديد، معتمدة، تم التسليم، في رحلة، انتهت.

ابدأ رحلتك بضغطة واحدة
بعد استلام السيارة اضغط «بدء الرحلة»، فيبدأ تسجيل المسار وتتحول حالة الطلب إلى «في رحلة» مباشرة في النظام.

تتبع موثوق حتى بدون إنترنت
• يُسجَّل المسار في الخلفية حتى لو أُغلق التطبيق.
• عند انقطاع الشبكة تُحفظ نقاط المسار على جوالك وتُرسل تلقائيًا عند عودة الاتصال، دون فقدان أو تكرار.
• يدعم الرحلات الطويلة التي تمتد لأكثر من يوم.
• تعرض شاشة الرحلة المسافة والمدة والسرعة، وحالة التتبع والبطارية وآخر مزامنة.

بلّغ عن أي مشكلة من مكانها
حادث أو تعطل في المركبة؟ اكتب وصفًا مختصرًا وأرفق الصور، ويُرفق موقعك تلقائيًا. يصل البلاغ فورًا إلى مدير النظام، ويستمر تسجيل المسار.

اطلب سيارتك في ثوانٍ
اختر من السيارات المتاحة فقط، وحدد موعد المغادرة والعودة والغرض من الرحلة، وأضف ملاحظاتك. يُرسل الطلب إلى مدير النظام للموافقة، ويصلك إشعار بالقرار.

إشعارات فورية
تصلك التنبيهات المهمة أولًا بأول: الموافقة على طلبك، وتسليم السيارة، وأي تحديث على رحلاتك.

حسابك
اطّلع على عدد رحلاتك والكيلومترات التي قطعتها، وتحكم في لغة التطبيق وصلاحيات الموقع.

بالعربية والإنجليزية
واجهة كاملة باللغتين، تتغير اتجاهاتها حسب اللغة التي تختارها.

ملاحظة: التطبيق مخصص لموظفي الجهات التي تستخدم نظام حركة  لإدارة الحركة والمركبات من بردية تك، ويتطلب حسابًا من الشركة التي تعمل بالنظام. يستخدم التطبيق موقعك في الخلفية أثناء الرحلة فقط، من لحظة بدء الرحلة حتى انتهائها.

name: Home Inventory: Insurance Log
description:
Home Inventory keeps a record of what you own, room by room. If you ever need to file an insurance claim after a fire, theft or water damage, or when you move, you can show what was in your home, with photos.

WHAT YOU CAN RECORD
• Photos (several per item), name, room, purchase date, price and currency, manufacturer, model, serial number and notes
• Totals per room and for the whole home. Amounts in different currencies are listed side by side, never added up or converted
• Search by name, manufacturer, model or serial number
• Rename, add and reorder rooms

NAME AND ROOM SUGGESTIONS FROM A PHOTO
Take or choose a photo of an item and your iPhone recognizes what it is, then suggests a name and a room. The top suggestion is filled in only when the name is empty; a name you typed is never replaced. Some items can't be recognized; then just type the name.

READ RATING PLATES AND RECEIPTS
Photograph the rating plate (the label on the back or bottom of a product) or a receipt, and the app suggests model, serial number, manufacturer, price and purchase date. Tap a suggestion to fill in the field, or pick any line from the recognized text.

PDF AND CSV FOR INSURANCE CLAIMS
• PDF: a cover page with totals per room, then each item with photos and details (A4 or Letter)
• CSV: for spreadsheets; separator and decimal mark follow your iPhone's region
• Export a single room if you like. You choose where to send the file: Mail, Files, print and more

NO INTERNET CONNECTION
The app never connects to the internet. Photos and records stay on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. There is no server backup, so export a PDF or CSV from time to time and keep it somewhere other than your phone.

PRICE
Free for up to 10 items, with every feature. To add more, buy Unlimited Unlock once. No subscription. Reaching the limit never blocks viewing, editing or exporting the items you have. Family Sharing supported.

PLEASE NOTE
Text recognition and item recognition are automatic and can be wrong; check the fields before saving. How your records are used in a claim depends on your insurer and your policy.

Requires iOS 26 or later on iPhone. Available in English, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Italian, Spanish and Japanese. Supports VoiceOver.

name: Hush Trail
description:
Hush Trail is a colorful game of movement, timing, and clever choices. Roll to walk, stop when the watcher turns, and find your way through glowing lantern paths.

Choose between three lanes, collect lanterns, and decide when to spend your supplies. Hop forward on green, arm a Veil to protect your next mistake, or Mend a thorny lane to create a safer crossing. Each decision can change the path ahead.

Journey mode connects three crossings with shared lives and Hops. Between crossings, choose a camp supply and pick your next route. Different terrains, path goals, and rewards give you new reasons to explore. Earn Wayfinder XP, unlock charms for future journeys, and collect new character colors and lantern styles.

Take on handcrafted challenges, chase your best score in Endless play, or pass the phone around for a local party. From gentle practice to quick reactions, Hush Trail lets you find your own rhythm.

Keep moving. Watch the turn. Make every step count.

name: Il Delfino - Civitavecchia
description:
The official app of Ristorante Il Delfino, on the Civitavecchia seafront.
Traditional cuisine with a modern twist, specialising in raw seafood.

BOOK IN SECONDS — pick the day, time and party size and get instant confirmation.
GIFT CARDS — give a dinner at Il Delfino to anyone, even at the last minute.
FIDELITY CARD — your loyalty card always with you: collect points on every visit.
NEWS & EXCLUSIVE OFFERS — holiday menus, special evenings and offers for app users.
EVERYTHING AT HAND — opening hours, directions, call and WhatsApp in one tap.

name: Jorithorn
description:
A tent's spec sheet lists the floor. Once the guy lines are out, that same tent can claim three or four times the ground. Jorithorn shows the whole spread at true size, right where you plan to sleep, so you know it fits between the trees and rocks before the first stake goes in.

LAY IT ON THE GROUND
Point your phone at the clearing and drop a tent footprint on it. Turn it with a tap, and every guy line and stake appears where it would really land. The door's compass heading is read from your phone, and trees, rocks or logs you mark are checked against the spread.

FOUR TENT SHAPES
Dome, tunnel, A-frame and pyramid, each with its own guying pattern. Set floor length, width and guy-out distance from your tent's manual. Jorithorn gives you the stake count, the guyed-out area and the clear patch you need, side to side and front to back.

DOOR AND WIND
Set where the wind comes from and how hard it blows. You get plain advice: door sheltered, side-on, or facing the wind, and one tap swings the door to the better heading. In gusty weather it suggests running the guys further out.

GROUP CAMPS
Add several tents and choose the gap you want between them. Each tent is marked clear, tight or clashing. Line up downwind turns every door away from the wind and spaces the row so no guy lines cross.

TRIPS, GEAR AND NOTES
Each trip gets a packing list. Link it to a saved site and the stake, guy-line and spare cord counts fill themselves in. Keep a trail log of every stop with notes on ground, shelter and water.

THE PLANNER WORKS EVERYWHERE
AR needs an iPhone with an A9 chip or later. On any device, and whenever the camera is off, the top-down planner does the same job: drag trees and tents around, set the wind, and load a sample space to try it all.

YOURS, ON YOUR PHONE
Everything works without an account, and guest data never leaves the phone. If you want your sites and trips backed up and in step across phones, an optional free account syncs them. The camera feed is never recorded or uploaded; snapshots stay on the phone.

Jorithorn gives pitching guidance from the sizes you enter. It does not certify that a site is safe, so always look up for loose branches and follow local camping rules.

name: JPARHD
description: JPARHDSuunniteltu käyttäjille, joiden täytyy kirjata tapahtumia jälkikäteen, korjata merkintöjä tai täsmäyttää tuloja ja menoja kuukausitasolla. Voit syöttää summia (USD), määrittää tilit sekä merkitä todelliset maksu- tai vastaanottopäivät. Kuukauden päätteeksi voit tallentaa kirjanpidon ja lisätä täsmäytysmerkintöjä. ”Playback”-näkymässä voit valita tietyn kuukauden ja aiemman version tarkastellaksesi rinnakkain kyseisen ajankohdan alkusaldoa, tuloja, menoja ja loppusaldoa. Voit myös porautua yksityiskohtiin ja tarkistaa kunkin yksittäisen tapahtuman summan ja päivämäärän. Olipa kyseessä unohtuneiden menojen lisääminen, summien korjaaminen, päivämäärien muuttaminen (vaikka kuukausien välillä) tai päällekkäisten merkintöjen poistaminen, näet reaaliajassa, miten muutokset vaikuttavat saldoon ja seuraavan kuukauden alkusaldoon. Palautukset voidaan yhdistää alkuperäisiin menoihin, ja kuukausien väliset siirrot on helppo kirjata tarkasti määrittelemällä sekä varojen lähtöpäivä että vastaanottopäivä. Tapahtumat, joiden päivämäärä on epävarma tai jotka saattavat olla päällekkäisiä, on koottu ”Review”-sivulle, mikä helpottaa niiden vertailua tiliotteisiin.

name: Julkul
description:
Julkul är en adventskalender full av arkadspel. Varje dag från 1 december öppnas en ny lucka, och bakom den väntar ett nytt spel att spela, slå rekord i och komma tillbaka till.

Arkadhallen har fått virus. Den korrupta huvudprocessorn Kernel skickar ut glitchar i alla maskiner, och städroboten Nibs, rivalen Volt och resten av Pixel Crew hoppar in i spel efter spel för att städa upp.

I KALENDERN
• Labyrintjakt, rymdformationer och asteroidfält
• Plattformsklättring, fallande block och tunnelgrävning
• Paddelspel, bombjakt i serverhallen och fighting en mot en
• Över vägen och floden, landa farkosten, försvara planeten med mera

SPELA SOM DU VILL
• iPhone med styrspak eller pilar på skärmen
• Apple TV med Siri Remote eller handkontroll
• Topplista för varje spel, både på enheten och i Game Center

Efter julafton är alla luckor öppna, så samlingen går att spela hela året.

Ingen reklam, inga köp i appen och ingen inloggning.

name: Kapital: Money & Budget
description:
Kapital shows how much money you have in total: cards and cash in any currency, deposits with accrued interest, stocks and crypto minus loans. One number in tenge, dollars or any other currency — at the official National Bank of Kazakhstan rate.

EXPENSES IN 2 TAPS
• Amount on the built-in keypad, tap a category — saved.
• Categories made for Kazakhstan, recurring payments with reminders.
• Transfers between your accounts with currency exchange at the official or your own rate.

MONTHLY BUDGET
• Budget ring and category tiles “spent / limit”, how much you can spend per day.

DEPOSITS
• Daily-balance interest with monthly capitalization, top-ups and withdrawals, rate changes, maturity reminder.

LOANS
• Annuity or differentiated schedule, early repayment “shorter term” or “lower payment” with the savings, rate changes, payment reminders.

DEBTS, STOCKS AND CRYPTO
• Who owes whom with return reminders.
• KASE and other stocks at the price you enter; crypto prices update automatically.

REPORTS
• Spending by category, income and expenses by month, CSV export for Excel.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• No sign-up, everything is stored on your phone. Face ID lock, “hide amounts”, encrypted backup file.

Russian, Kazakh and English, dark and light themes.

Tracking only: the app does not take payments, issue loans, buy or sell anything or give investment advice. Calculations are approximate; exact figures are at your bank. Rates: National Bank of Kazakhstan; crypto prices: CoinGecko.

name: Kıvılcım: Takımyıldız Avı
description:
Kıvılcım is a calm yet addictive one-finger sky game.

Drag the moon, lift your finger and launch the spark. Where the spark lands on the moon decides where it goes: the edge sends it sideways, the center sends it straight up. Gather the stars, complete the constellation, move on to the next.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag: move the moon.
• Release: launch the spark.
• Every star you gather in a row is worth more.
• Hit the bright center of the moon to keep your combo going.
• Catch the passing shooting star: +25 points.

18 REAL CONSTELLATIONS
The Hunter, Great Bear, The Queen, The Swan, Southern Cross and more. Every constellation you complete goes into your album.

TODAY'S SKY
Everyone plays the same constellations each day. Beat the day's best and keep your streak alive.

DAY AND NIGHT
Day theme when the sun is up, night when it sets. You can lock either one from the menu. The sky changes color with every constellation and the game speeds up a little.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• No internet needed, play anywhere.
• No ads, no purchases, no account.
• No data collected.
• A short tutorial welcomes you on your first game.
• Respects silent mode and won't stop your music.
• Follows the system "Reduce Motion" setting.

name: Knapp! – Brake at the Edge
description:
Your car is rolling towards the cliff. You get exactly ONE tap: full brake! Will you stop in time – and how close to the edge? Every centimetre counts.

ONE FINGER, INSTANTLY UNDERSTOOD
Tap to brake – that's all. Perfect for a quick break, for kids, parents and grandparents.

FIVE VEHICLES, EACH DRIVES DIFFERENTLY
Car, truck, tractor, shopping cart and a shunting locomotive that has to stop before the buffer stop. Each with its own engine and brake sounds.

WEATHER AND SURFACES
Asphalt, rain, gravel or black ice – on ice you slide forever.

DAILY EDGE
5 new rides every day – the same for every player. Compare with friends and keep your daily streak alive.

ENDLESS MODE
Every round you must stop closer. The music speeds up every round. How far can you go?

CHALLENGE FRIENDS
Send your result – your friends drive exactly the same rides and have to beat you.

No ads. No purchases. No account. Works completely offline.
(The game itself is in German.)

name: Kreiselwerkstatt
description:
Kreiselwerkstatt is a physics puzzle about a spinning top that you turn yourself.

Throw the top across a wooden board and knock down every pin with one throw. Do that and you earn the workshop stamp.

The lathe
On the lathe you shape your own top. Its shape changes the physics: it sets speed, running time, spin, impact and bounce. Your own tops clear boards, daily boards and streaks. Stamps and medals need the workshop top.

Masterpieces
Every chapter has a masterpiece with four or five pins. The workshop top will hardly do: you have to turn the right top for it.

Six chapters, 60 boards
The Cushion: brass bounces back, wood soaks up speed.
The Spin: the stronger your swipe arc, the tighter the top turns.
The Beat: the same throw only works at the right moment.
The Magnet: red attracts, teal repels.
The Turntable: the turntable carries the top along and changes direction with the beat.
The Clockwork: flaps stay shut for two beats and open for one.

When you are stuck
After three failed throws a hint helps: first the direction, then the whole swipe at the right moment.

Chalk prediction
Draw in chalk how the top will run. Then throw and see how accurate your prediction was. Good predictions earn chalk stars and new colours for your tops.

Music and haptics
The moving parts follow the 3/4 waltz of the soundtrack. The device vibrates on throw, hit and stamp. Music, sounds and haptics can each be switched off.

Daily board
Every day there is a new daily board from one of the six chapters, with an optional reminder and a Game Center leaderboard. The full version also opens the daily boards of the last 60 days.

iPad and iPhone Duo
On large displays the board lies on a whole workbench with a top shelf, a slate and all boards of the chapter.

Free and full version
Free: the whole first chapter, the first board of every other chapter, today’s daily board and one top of your own.
The full version is a one-time purchase. It unlocks all 60 boards, the six masterpieces, the daily boards of the last 60 days and five tops of your own. No ads, no subscription.

Privacy
Kreiselwerkstatt collects no data. There are no ads, no analytics and no account. Your progress stays on your device and, if you use iCloud, in your iCloud storage. Apple handles purchases. The leaderboard uses Game Center if you are signed in.

name: Kyoryn
description:
A loft bed listing tells you the deck height. It never tells you whether the person sleeping up there can sit up without meeting the ceiling. Kyoryn answers that before you spend the money and the afternoon with an Allen key.

Point your phone at the floor, tap where the bed would stand, and Kyoryn builds the frame in your room: posts, deck, mattress and ladder. Then it seats a figure on the mattress at your sitting height and measures the gap from the top of that head to your real ceiling. Tap the ceiling, or type its height if it is too plain for the camera to find.

What you can check
- Frame presets: low loft, mid loft, high loft and bunk, each with an editable deck height and mattress thickness. Bunks also show the room left for whoever sits on the bottom deck.
- Sitting height: worked out from standing height, or typed in if you have measured it.
- Ceiling fan and light check: how far the fixture hangs, how wide it is and how far it sits from the head. Fans get a bigger safety margin than lamps.
- Under-bed use: will a desk, wardrobe or sofa fit underneath, counting a person sitting there and not only the furniture.
- Saved rooms: every save is a revision. Search, sort by tightest fit, rename, copy or delete, with undo if you change your mind.

The highest deck that still leaves comfortable room is shown for every room, so you can compare listings quickly.

AR needs an iPhone with an A9 chip or later. The elevation planner works everywhere: a side drawing of the room with a slider for every number, the same maths and the same verdicts, plus a sample dorm room to try straight away.

AR captures stay on your phone. The camera feed is never recorded or uploaded.

An account is optional. Without one, everything works and none of your data leaves your phone. With one, your saved rooms are backed up and sync between devices, and you can delete the account from inside the app at any time.

The numbers come from you or the bed maker's manual. Kyoryn gives honest guidance, not a safety certificate, so check the manufacturer's height and weight limits before anyone climbs up.

name: Las Hijas del Rey
description:
Las Hijas del Rey es un espacio para la mujer de hoy en Cristo Jesús. Cada semana recibes devocionales escritos por mujeres que aman a Dios, el podcast «Un Momento Con El Rey» y retos de lectura bíblica para crecer en tu fe.

LEE Y ESCUCHA LA PALABRA
• Devocionales cortos para cada día, escritos por la Pastora Kilsia Delossantos y un equipo de escritoras.
• Escucha cada devocional en audio, mientras manejas, cocinas o descansas.
• Mira las historias animadas de los devocionales y del podcast.

EL PODCAST «UN MOMENTO CON EL REY»
• Todos los episodios en un solo lugar, con su reproductor.

RETOS DE LECTURA Y MI ESPACIO
• Únete a los retos de lectura bíblica y marca cada día que completas.
• Guarda tus devocionales favoritos.
• Escribe tu diario de oración: es solo tuyo, nadie más lo ve.
• Comenta los devocionales con otras hermanas (cada comentario lo revisa el ministerio antes de publicarse).

AVISOS
• Te avisamos cuando sale un devocional nuevo, un episodio o un reto, si así lo quieres.

LIBROS
• «Madres que oran»: 30 devocionales de intercesión y esperanza, de la Pastora Kilsia Delossantos. Disponible en Amazon, Walmart y Barnes & Noble.

La app es gratis. Puedes leer sin cuenta; si creas una, puedes eliminarla cuando quieras desde «Mi espacio».

«Porque yo sé los pensamientos que tengo acerca de vosotros, dice Jehová, pensamientos de paz, y no de mal, para daros el fin que esperáis.» Jeremías 29:11

name: Light Now Team
description:
Light Now Team bringt die tägliche Arbeit aus dem ERP der Light Now AG aufs Handy. Was du siehst und tun darfst, richtet sich nach deinen Rechten im ERP, genau wie am PC.

NUR FÜR MITARBEITER
Die App ist für Mitarbeiter der Light Now AG mit ERP-Zugang. Ein Konto legt die Verwaltung der Light Now AG an; in der App kann man sich nicht registrieren.

HEUTE
• Auf einen Blick, was auf dich wartet
• Mitteilungen aus dem ERP, auf Wunsch zusätzlich per Mail

FREIGABEN
• Zahlungen, Rechnungen, Belege, Spesen und Urlaub freigeben oder ablehnen
• Jede Freigabe bestätigst du mit Face ID oder Fingerabdruck auf deinem eingerichteten Gerät

KUNDEN, LIEFERANTEN UND ANLEGER
• Kundenakte mit Umsatz, offenen Rechnungen, Verträgen, Kontakten, Adressen und Dateien
• Verlauf mit allen Mails; Mails schreibst du mit Vorschau, gesendet wird erst nach deiner Bestätigung
• Lieferantenakte mit Eingangsrechnungen, Konten, Kontakten und Besuchen
• Anleger mit Verträgen, Auszahlungen und Briefen (nur mit Berechtigung)

RECHNUNGEN
• Ausgangs- und Eingangsrechnungen an einem Ort, mit Suche, Filter und Summen
• Rechnungsentwürfe anlegen

TICKETS UND TELEFON
• Tickets lesen, beantworten, zuweisen und mit Notizen versehen
• Anrufliste mit verpassten Anrufen und Rückrufen
• Anrufen über die Telefonanlage der Firma: dein Telefon klingelt, dann wird verbunden
• Aus einem Anruf Notiz, Rückruf, Termin oder Ticket machen

VERTRIEB UND SHOP
• Leads, Chancen und Angebote
• Shop-Artikel mit Bestand und Preisen, Angebote und Kennzahlen der Werbekampagnen

ARBEITSZEIT, URLAUB UND SPESEN
• Kommen, Gehen und Pause stempeln, mit Arbeitsort; Zeit nachtragen
• Urlaub beantragen und sehen, wer im Team abwesend ist
• Spesen mit Belegfoto einreichen

AUFGABEN UND KI
• Aufgaben anlegen, zuweisen, kommentieren und erledigen
• Suche über Kunden, Tickets, Rechnungen und mehr
• Die eingebaute KI (Mistral AI) beantwortet Fragen zu ERP-Daten und schlägt Texte vor. Sie liest nur; senden und freigeben tust immer du. Bevor deine erste Frage an die KI geht, fragt die App dich um Zustimmung.

SICHER
• Anmeldung über die Anmeldeseite der Light Now AG mit Zwei-Faktor-Code; die App speichert kein Passwort
• Nach einer Minute im Hintergrund sperrt sich die App und öffnet sich mit Face ID oder Fingerabdruck (im Profil abschaltbar)
• Keine Werbung, kein Tracking

Hilfe: Profil › Problem melden schickt eine Mail an den Support, Version und Gerät stehen schon drin.

name: LineLens: Video Teleprompter
description:
LineLens is a camera-first video teleprompter built to keep your eyes locked naturally on the lens—with zero watermarks, zero accounts, and zero cloud uploads. Shoot Shorts, Reels, YouTube videos, keynotes, and interviews in one clean take.

[Camera-First Broadcast Viewfinder]
• Opens directly into a full-bleed camera viewfinder with a translucent script glass pinned directly below the front lens.
• Cyan eye-line reading guide and adjustable horizontal margins prevent noticeable eye drift.
• Rule-of-thirds framing grid, 0/3/5-second countdown, instant front/back camera flip, and direct watermark-free saving to Photos.

[Exact WPM Pacing & On-Device Voice Sync]
• Fine-tune scroll velocity from 60 to 260 WPM with live estimated reading time as you write.
• Highlight stage cues like [PAUSE], [SMILE], or [LOOK AT LENS] automatically inside your script.
• Voice-Pace auto-scroll listens locally on-device so the script pauses automatically when you improvise or breathe and resumes the instant you speak.

[Beam-Splitter Rig & Hands-Free Remote]
• Switch to pure-black high-contrast Rig Mirror mode for glass beam-splitter teleprompter hoods or standalone presenting.
• Horizontal, vertical, or dual-axis Mirror Mode for physical teleprompter glass.
• Bluetooth page-turner & hardware keyboard support (Space to play/pause, Up/Down arrows for WPM ±10).

[Clean Free Core, Optional Pro Upgrade]
Record watermark-free 1080p video, save up to 3 scripts, and adjust WPM speed, font size, glass opacity, margins, and countdown completely free and ad-free. Upgrade to Pro to unlock unlimited scripts & .txt/.md import, 4K Ultra HD recording, Voice-Pace auto-scroll, Mirror Mode, and Bluetooth/keyboard remote controls.

name: Lingoku: Language Crosswords
description:
Lingoku turns vocabulary into a puzzle habit. Read the Turkish clue, type the word in the language you are learning, and hear every word you solve in a natural voice.

FOUR LANGUAGES, SIX LEVELS
English, Spanish, French and Italian, each from A1 to C2 with hundreds of stages. You start with the most common words and they get harder as you go. Every 10 stages unlock a reward puzzle built from that chapter's words.

FIND YOUR LEVEL
A short placement test starts you in the right place.

WORDS THAT STICK
Every word goes into your notebook. Spaced repetition brings back the words you are starting to forget at the right moment.

NATURAL PRONUNCIATION
Every word and example sentence is read in a natural voice.

SUDOKU AND WORDOKU
Easy, medium, hard and expert sudoku. Wordoku uses letters instead of digits and reveals a hidden word when solved.

A REASON TO COME BACK
Daily puzzle and mini puzzle, streaks, badges and leaderboards, with an optional daily reminder.

LINGOKU PLUS
The first stages of every level are free. Plus unlocks every stage, removes ads and lifts the hint limit. Choose monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of use (EULA): https://lingoku.app/terms
Privacy policy: https://lingoku.app/privacy

name: Lyrisand
description:
Every good aquascape starts before the water. Lyrisand helps you plan a tank the way an experienced keeper would: measure first, count the bags, check the stand, then fill.

MEASURE ON THE STAND
Point your phone at the stand and tap three corners. Lyrisand reads the footprint, raises a glass box to your chosen height and fills it with a translucent block of water up to the waterline. A wedge of substrate shows the front and back depth of your slope inside the glass. Prefer to try a size first? Drop a virtual tank on the stand and turn it until it sits right.

THE PLANNER WORKS EVERYWHERE
No camera handy, or a device without AR? The 2D planner does every sum from typed dimensions, with a side view of the tank that fills and slopes as you type. A sample tank is one tap away so you can see the tools at work.

WHAT YOU LEARN
- Gross and net volume in litres and US gallons, with glass thickness, the gap below the rim, the solid part of the bed and stone displacement taken off.
- How many bags of aqua soil, sand or gravel a front-to-back slope needs, from your bag size, plus the slope angle and the bed weight.
- Total filled weight (glass, water, bed, stone and equipment), the load on the stand top and the share per leg. Enter the rating from the stand maker's manual to compare. The figures are guidance, not certification.
- A water-change log that shows each change as a share of net volume, and a reading log for temperature, pH, KH, GH, nitrate and phosphate drawn as charts. It records your numbers and gives no care advice.
- Saved tanks with search, filters, rename, copy and remove with undo, each with a photo-free layout sketch of stones, wood and plants seen from above.

YOUR DATA
Everything works without an account, and guest tanks never leave the phone. If you want your tanks on more than one phone, create an optional account and they sync. The camera feed is never recorded or uploaded; captures you take stay on the phone.

AR needs an iPhone with an A9 chip or later. The planner works on every supported device.

Metric or imperial, sound and haptics switches, and a calm dark design drawn like light moving through deep water.

name: Matriz Dashboard
description:
O Matriz Dashboard leva os números da sua confecção para o celular. Os dados vêm direto do ERP Matriz da sua empresa, organizados em cards claros, com comparação com o período anterior e gráficos para entender o que está acontecendo.

RESUMO DO MÊS
• Faturamento da indústria e das lojas, com a variação em relação ao período anterior
• Contas a receber e a pagar, com as parcelas do período
• Transferências entre indústria e lojas

name: Mind Gambit
description:
Out-think the other side of the table.

Mind Gambit is a set of short, sharp duels you can finish in about four minutes. Each one tests a different part of how you think, and every ranked win counts.

• Grid Enclosure: close cells, chain your turns and fight over the double squares. Walls and bonuses move every match. 2 to 8 players, or share one phone.

• Chrono Grid: deduce a sealed grid. Call early for a bigger bounty, or wait until you are sure.
• Counterweight: hang orbs and leave the beam perfectly level.
• Recall Draft: draft emblems you saw once, while tiles trade places.
• Survey: hide your land and find theirs from numbers alone.
• Undertow: move before the announced current drags the board.
• Afterimage: spot the one thing that changed, and say how sure you are.
• Ledger: sign the contract nobody else does.

PEOPLE FIRST, THE HOUSE IN RESERVE

RIVALS WITH CHARACTER

KNOW YOUR OWN MIND
After each match, see what you risked, read and missed. A four-axis chart follows your logic, memory, psychology and calculation.

ENTRIES
A match uses one entry. You hold up to five free entries and one returns every two hours. Extra entries can be bought. Points inside the games are only for scoring: they cannot be bought, sold or exchanged.

name: Ribora
description:
# Ribora — Umbrella Inspection & Repair

**Ribora** is a practical tool application focused on umbrella structural inspection, fault recording, maintenance management, and re-inspection tracking. It helps users manage the daily maintenance and repair of umbrellas in a clearer and more systematic way.

The application uses intuitive umbrella canopy partition diagrams and rib structure diagrams to allow users to accurately mark fault locations, record issues such as canopy damage, seam cracks, rib deformation, joint loosening, and abnormal opening and closing, and create a complete inspection file.

### Core Functions

**Canopy Inspection (Canopy)** Through an interactive canopy partition diagram, users can distinguish inspection areas one by one, recording leaks, damage, wear, and seam abnormalities. It supports fault location marking, severity classification, photo addition, and inspection report generation.

**Structural Inspection (Ribs)** Classifies and inspects the main umbrella ribs, support ribs, joints, slides, and center rod, recording conditions such as bending, loosening, corrosion, and jamming, and creating detailed component maintenance records.

**Opening and Closing Test (Cycle)** Provides an opening and closing cycle counting tool, supporting the setting of test targets, recording of abnormal events, pausing and resuming tests, and comparing results of different tests through historical records.

**Repair Management (Repair)** Creates independent repair work orders, managing fault sources, repair steps, material usage, operation time, and before-and-after photos. Clearly tracks each repair task through process progress and re-inspection records.

**History Archives (History)** Centrally stores inspection, fault, repair, and re-inspection records, supporting filtering by date and event type, viewing a complete maintenance timeline, and exporting inspection and repair reports.

### More Features

- Independent filing and categorized management of multiple umbrellas

- Visualized umbrella surface and structural fault location

- Complete process tracking for inspection, repair, and re-inspection

- Recording of repair materials and operation time

- Comparison of historical inspection results

- Local PDF report export

- No account registration required; core functions available offline

- Data stored locally on the device, supporting backup and recovery

Ribora integrates structural inspection, repair operations, and historical records into a clear workspace. Whether it's routine umbrella maintenance, troubleshooting, or organizing personal repair projects, it helps users systematically record every detail.

**Ribora — Inspect. Repair. Preserve.**

Making every inspection recorded, and every repair traceable.

name: Rimstride
description:
Make a plan for the wheels you already own.

Rimstride is an offline wheel rearrangement workbench for inline skaters, coaches and small workshops. Enter your measured diameters, define which wheels can exchange positions, and compare arrangements before changing your setup. With equal axle heights, a 2 mm difference in diameter changes the wheel-bottom height by 1 mm.

FROM MEASUREMENTS TO A FINISHED ARRANGEMENT

1. Build your wheel inventory
Create a setup for six or eight wheels. Give each wheel an ID and enter its measured diameter individually or as a complete measurement session.

2. Set your frame and target
Enter axle-height offsets and adjust target bottom heights in 0.1 mm steps. Choose Flat, Banana or Front lift as a starting point, then refine the profile to suit your experiment.

3. Define which exchanges are allowed
Keep wheels within the same skate, allow exchanges only between matching left and right positions, or let wheels move across both skates. Specify permitted wheel IDs at individual positions and lock any position you want to preserve.

4. Explore the trade-offs
Rimstride evaluates every permitted arrangement, up to 40,320 possibilities for eight wheels. Set a movement budget and compare profile RMS error, left/right differences and the number of wheels that change position. Sort by the closest target, fewer moves or better balance. Tap the interactive chart to inspect a choice, or use the efficient-choice filter to narrow the results.

5. Preview the changes
Overlay the current, proposed and target profiles. Review each wheel's destination and the height changes at individual positions. Drag wheels to exchange them manually, inspect the frame cross-section, or apply a candidate virtually for another experiment.

6. Take the plan to the bench
Create an installation ticket with a source and destination for every moved wheel. Mark placements as you work, pause and resume later, then record the completed arrangement after your checks. Changes to source measurements or fit rules block outdated tickets.

7. Keep the measurement history
Add new diameter readings over time and view each wheel's history. Start a fresh history for a replacement wheel. Save, rename, duplicate and reload multiple setups. Completed bench records preserve the before-and-after configurations used for each decision.

READY FOR THE WORKSHOP

Export a wheel-position map as CSV or share an installation ticket through the system share sheet. Designed for iPhone and iPad, with a two-column workbench on wider screens.

LOCAL BY DESIGN

No account, advertising, tracking or connected hardware is required. Measurements, setups and installation records are stored locally, and calculations work offline.

Rimstride models static geometry from your inputs. It does not simulate loaded wheel contact, predict skating performance or certify physical compatibility. Verify frame clearance, axle security and manufacturer limits before riding.

If you find the change, tap it and report it. If nothing changed, move on. A correct call takes you to the next room. A wrong one… back to Room 1.
