name: Expend AI
description:
Expend te ayuda a anotar tus gastos en segundos y a ver cuánto te queda, en casa y de viaje.

PRESUPUESTOS PARA TU CASA Y TUS VIAJES
• Define cuánto quieres gastar por mes o por viaje y mira cuánto te queda por día y por categoría.
• Anota un gasto con el botón +: monto, categoría y listo.
• Varias monedas, con cotizaciones automáticas o el tipo de cambio que elijas.

TARJETAS SIN SORPRESAS
• Límite, cierre, vencimiento y cuotas de cada tarjeta.
• Avisos antes del cierre y del vencimiento.
• El número completo de tus tarjetas no sale de tu teléfono: queda cifrado y se muestra solo con Face ID o tu código.

TODO TU MES
• Ingresos de varias personas, facturas, gastos fijos, cuotas y vencimientos, juntos en un calendario.
• Metas de ahorro, con la opción de apartar una parte cada vez que cobras.
• Proyección de lo que te queda después de tus compromisos.

VIAJES COMPARTIDOS
• Carga los gastos con amigos o en pareja: Expend calcula quién le debe a quién y puedes compartir el resumen.

INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL
• Toma una foto de un ticket o abre un PDF: la IA lee cada artículo, su precio y su categoría, y tú lo revisas antes de guardarlo.
• También lee los resúmenes de tu tarjeta.
• Análisis de tu mes con IA, con ideas para gastar mejor.
Lo que lee la IA puede tener errores: siempre puedes corregirlo.

ESTADÍSTICAS
• Gráficos por mes y por categoría, comparativas y promedios.

TU CUENTA Y TUS DATOS
• Necesitas una cuenta gratuita (email, Google o Apple). Tus datos quedan en tu teléfono y en tu cuenta: si cambias de teléfono, entras y están.
• Sin publicidad, sin rastreo y sin venta de datos.
• Bloqueo de la app con Face ID o tu código.
• Puedes eliminar tu cuenta y todos tus datos desde la app.
• En 47 idiomas, con widgets para la pantalla de inicio.

PLANES
• Gratis: un presupuesto activo (un viaje o un mes de tu casa), registro manual, categorías, varias monedas y estadísticas básicas.
• Viajes Plus: presupuestos y viajes ilimitados, tarjetas y medios de pago, viajes compartidos, filtros, exportar e importar en CSV y estadísticas avanzadas.
• Vida & Viajes: todo lo de Viajes Plus, más varios ingresos, facturas, gastos fijos, cuotas, calendario, proyecciones, ahorro automático y análisis con IA.
• Vida & Viajes IA: todo lo anterior, más el escáner de tickets y resúmenes de tarjeta con IA.

Las suscripciones son mensuales y se renuevan solas. El pago se cobra a tu cuenta de Apple al confirmar la compra y la suscripción se renueva salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes de que termine el período, desde los ajustes de tu cuenta de Apple. Por tiempo limitado, los nuevos suscriptores pagan un precio de lanzamiento; después, el precio normal.

Términos de uso: https://expendai.pro/terminos
Privacidad: https://expendai.pro/privacidad

Expend no es un asesor financiero: las cotizaciones, las proyecciones y lo que lee la IA son orientativos.

name: FirmPref Sleep Journal
description:
FirmRef Sleep Journal is a sleep diary that revolves around a question: What does it feel like to sleep on this mattress? Every night, all you need to do is record the softness and hardness of the mattress you slept on that day, as well as the quality of your sleep, duration of sleep, number of awakenings at night, and how you feel the next morning. After one or two weeks, these brief records will become a comparison table of your own, clearly telling you which type of support is more suitable for your back and shoulders.

The application is centered around a hardness scale of 1 to 10 and categorized into five ranges from "extremely soft" to "extremely hard", giving each number a clear meaning. A bar chart displays the average sleep quality you recorded on various hardness levels, a line chart shows the sleep trend over the past week, month, or three months, and a ring chart breaks down all your nights into soft and hard intervals. Click on any column, data point, or sector to see the specific night that makes up it.
There are no arbitrary ratings here, every chart comes from the nights you personally recorded. For those who once woke up stiff and doubted whether it was a problem with the mattress, FirmRef Sleep Journal is a quiet and practical notebook.

name: Florentino: La Última Porfía
description:
Una noche sin luna le robaron la voz al llano. Florentino, el Catire, sale a recuperarla.

Florentino: La Última Porfía es un juego de acción y exploración en pixel art sobre los mitos y leyendas de Venezuela. Recorre diez jornadas: nueve espantos y, al final, la porfía contra el Diablo.

• El arsenal del llanero: machete, látigo, china, cuchillo y más.
• Jefes de la tradición: el Jinete sin Cabeza, la Llorona, la Sayona, el Silbón y otros.
• Un relato narrado en español acompaña el viaje.
• Cancionero con las canciones de cada jornada.
• Leyendas, códice y mapa del viaje para saber dónde se cuenta cada historia.
• Controles táctiles para jugar en horizontal.
• Gratis, sin anuncios, sin compras y sin conexión.

Contiene escenas de miedo y violencia fantástica.

name: Froststride
description:
Froststride brings the playground game of freeze tag to life in an offline, single-player rescue adventure. Dodge taggers, find openings around obstacles, and use a well-timed dash to escape a close chase.

When a teammate gets tagged, they freeze in place. Move nearby and hold CRAWL to align with the opening, crawl beneath their legs, and bring them back into the action. Choose your moment carefully—every rescue puts another runner back on the field and gives your crew another chance to survive.

Explore three ways to play. Survive the chase in Park Circuit, tackle 24 objective-based Rescue Routes, or customize your park, round duration, tagger count, and field rules in Free Play. Link ground beacons in Relay Rush or chain successful rescues in Rescue Surge.

Build your rescue career through daily goals, achievements, three-stop journeys, and level rewards. Earn coins through gameplay, unlock cosmetic outfits, collect route medals, and improve your best results. Outfits change your appearance without changing your abilities.

Play entirely offline, with no account or internet connection required. Your progress and settings stay saved on your device, ready for your next run.

name: GroggyBye: Light Sleep Alarm
description:
GroggyBye wakes you at the lightest point in your sleep, so you get up refreshed instead of groggy.

It watches your heart rate through the night and rings at the best moment inside the window you choose. If the connection ever drops, a guaranteed backstop alarm still rings at your set time, so you never oversleep.

WORKS WITH ANY WEARABLE THAT BROADCASTS HEART RATE OVER BLUETOOTH
- WHOOP - broadcasts automatically
- Garmin watches - turn on Broadcast Heart Rate
- Chest straps - Polar H10, Wahoo TICKR, COOSPO and similar
- Arm bands - Polar Verity Sense and similar

DOES NOT WORK WITH TRACKERS THAT ONLY SYNC TO THE CLOUD
Smart rings and smart beds - Oura, Ultrahuman, RingConn, Samsung Galaxy Ring, Eight Sleep - do not broadcast a live heart-rate signal, so no alarm app can read them while you sleep. The rule is simple: if your device can broadcast heart rate over standard Bluetooth, GroggyBye works with it.

HOW IT WORKS
- An on-device engine estimates when you fall asleep and stages your night from your heart rate.
- The alarm rings at the first light-sleep moment inside your window.
- A guaranteed backstop alarm always rings at your set time, even if the wearable disconnects.

ARMS ITSELF
Turn on auto-arm and set your earliest bedtime. Once your strap connects, the alarm arms itself and starts timing your sleep the moment you doze off. A Start Now button covers naps and off-schedule nights.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs on your phone. Your heart rate and sleep history never leave your device. No account, no cloud, no tracking, no ads.

WAKE YOUR WAY
Choose a built-in tone or wake to your own Spotify playlist. A tone always plays underneath as a guaranteed fallback.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://flowengine.cloud/groggybye/privacy

Sleep stages are estimated from heart rate for general wellness. GroggyBye is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition. Not affiliated with WHOOP, Garmin, Polar, Wahoo, COOSPO, Oura, Ultrahuman, RingConn, Samsung, Eight Sleep, Apple, or Spotify.

name: Hades Memorial
description:
Hades Memorial es un espacio para recordar a tus seres queridos.

Crea un memorial con su nombre, parentesco y forma de ser, agrega recuerdos, frases y anécdotas, y conversa con una simulación generada por inteligencia artificial a partir de lo que compartes. No es la persona real: es una herramienta de recuerdo.

Con Hades puedes:
• Crear memoriales y guardar recuerdos.
• Conversar por texto y escuchar las respuestas en voz.
• Elegir una voz de la biblioteca o clonar la voz de tu ser querido con audios que tengas derecho a usar. Las voces clonadas pasan a la biblioteca compartida sin su nombre.
• Reportar respuestas inapropiadas.
• Eliminar tu cuenta y tus datos desde la app.

Para generar las respuestas se usan proveedores externos de inteligencia artificial; la app te pide permiso antes de empezar. Solo para mayores de 18 años.

Hades no sustituye la ayuda profesional. Si estás atravesando un duelo difícil, busca el apoyo de un especialista.

name: KORN: B&W Film Camera
description:
KORN is a camera for people who love black and white. Pick a film, press the shutter, done. What you see in the viewfinder is the photo you get.

13 BLACK AND WHITE FILMS
Every film has its own character: its own grain, contrast and tone, built like a real film stock and not like a flat filter.
• KORN 400: the classic. Honest grain, deep blacks.
• PURE 100: clean and modern, almost no grain.
• SOFT 200: gentle contrast for everyday light.
• ATELIER 160: luminous skin and a soft glow, like a wedding photo.
• PUSH 1600: pushed two stops, raw and loud.
• NOIR 400: red filter drama and black skies.
• Plus PAN 50, SILK, STREET, FADE, SELEN, INFRA and PINHOLE.

A CAMERA THAT FEELS LIKE ONE
The interface is built like a 35mm camera: a chrome top plate, a frame counter, an exposure dial and one big shutter button. Shoot in 2:3 like 35mm film, in 3:4 or square.

THE DARKROOM
KORN keeps the original of every photo, so you can develop it again at any time: change the film, then fine-tune exposure, contrast, grain, vignette, fade, glow and tone. Add a white print border if you like.

DEVELOP PHOTOS YOU ALREADY HAVE
Import any picture from your library and give it the same film look.

PAY ONCE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
KORN is free with three films. KORN Pro unlocks all 13 films, the darkroom and photo import with a single one-time purchase.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your photos stay on your iPhone.

name: LastingValue
description:
The app is a market research and paper trading app for iPhone. Follow the markets, dig into individual stocks, and practice investment decisions.

- Follow the markets. Track major indices, sector trends, and market movers. Keep your watchlist handy and see upcoming earnings releases and economic events.
- Research stocks. Explore interactive price charts, financial statements, analyst ratings, and key statistics. Read market news in the app and save articles to revisit later.
- Practice trading. Place simulated orders, track your positions, and see how your portfolio changes as market prices move.
- Explore different scenarios. Compare stocks side by side, examine correlations, convert currencies, and model how contributions, returns, and time can affect long-term portfolio growth.

name: LegalSense - Expatriation
LengtePad
description:
Een munt ligt stil tussen twee tekendriehoeken. Links wijst de schaal 3,20 cm aan, rechts 5,45 cm. Daartussen resteert 2,25 cm: een verschil zo fijn dat een slordige zin het zo kan wegwuiven. LengtePad laat het niet wegwuiven. Een lengtemeting wordt vijf standaarden die je opnieuw kunt narekenen: aflezing, eenheid, methode, gebruik en verslag. Elke standaard telt vier onderdelen van 25 punten. Pas bij 100 verschijnt de conclusie, en gaat de volgende deur open.

Begin bij de liniaal. Noteer het kleinste schaaldeel, lees beide uiteinden af en schrijf de schatting voluit. De lengte is het rechteruiteinde min het linker. Ontbreekt één decimaal, dan blijft de conclusie achterwege. Wat al klopte, blijft staan. Het beginscherm noemt alleen het eerste ontbrekende onderdeel, zodat je niet de hele pagina opnieuw hoeft te doen.

Laat dezelfde lengte van jas wisselen. 2,25 cm is ook 22,5 mm, 0,0225 m en 2,25×10⁻² m. De schrijfwijze verandert, de gemeten lengte niet. Tijd hoort niet op de lengterij. Drie herhalingen geven een mediaan, of je stapelt minstens tien gelijke munten en deelt de hoogte. Een draadlengte blijft een draadlengte en glipt niet stilletjes de diameter in.

Gebruik de lengte daarna echt. Omtrek, gemiddelde snelheid en slinger vragen elk hun eigen voorwaarden. Het verslag heeft zeven velden, en de slotzin moet woordelijk dezelfde zijn als de gebruikszin. Een lege cel in de ruwe gegevens levert geen conclusie op. Een nog open misser houdt de honderd tegen. Wat overblijft, is een zin die je later nog kunt narekenen.

LengtePad laat in de klas zien tot welke standaard deze meting reikt, waarop de volgende beurt zich moet richten, en welke zin daarna blijft staan. Dit zijn standaarden voor de les. Ze vervangen geen examencijfer en geen ijking door een metrologisch instituut. De app volgt de systeemtaal: Nederlands, of vereenvoudigd Chinees.

name: Mim: Ezan, Namaz, Hatim
description:
Ezan vakitleri, kıble ve sevdiklerinle birlikte ibadet: hepsi tek, sade bir uygulamada. Reklamsız.

Ezan Vakitleri
• Konumuna göre vakitler ve canlı geri sayım
• Ezan bildirimi ve vakit öncesi hatırlatma
• Aylık imsakiye ve ana ekran widget'ları

Ortak Hatim
• Cüzleri sevdiklerinle paylaş, birlikte bitirin
• Kimin hangi cüzü okuduğunu gör

Salavat Zinciri
• Bir niyet için birlikte hedefe ulaşın
• Odaklı tam ekran zikir sayacı

Kıble ve Cami
• Pusula, harita ve yakındaki camiler

Namaz Takibi
• Beş vakit ve kaza takibi, yalnızca sana görünür

Gizliliğine Saygı
• Vakit, kıble ve Kur'an hesap açmadan çalışır
• Apple, Google ya da e-postayla giriş; telefon numarası istenmez

Gizlilik politikası: https://mymimapp.com/gizlilik
Kullanım koşulları: https://mymimapp.com/kosullar

name: Neon Pocket  Club
description:
Neon Pocket is a portrait billiards game for a short round on your phone. There is no account, no matchmaking, and no network connection.

Drag on the table to aim. Pull the cue back, or use the meter on the right, to set power. The guide shows the cue path, a ghost ball, and where the object ball will travel. A slider at the bottom fine-tunes the angle. The white-ball button adds follow, draw, or side spin.

There are 100 levels. Most levels are cleared by pocketing every object ball. Some levels are won by reaching a score. A later level uses a diamond-shaped table. Five hearts are shown at the start of a level. A cue ball that falls in, or a shot that never touches an object ball, costs one heart. A free-place token lets you put the cue ball down yourself.

The pink button opens the level map. The gear button opens pause, where music and haptics can be turned off. Coins shown with a "$" are an on-device score decoration. They cannot be bought, spent, or cashed out. Nothing in Neon Pocket is for sale.

name: Petrecipe
description:
Petrecipe is a recipe cost and portion calculator for anyone who wants to know what a dish really costs: home cooks on a budget, bakers pricing a bake sale, caterers quoting a party, or small cafés checking their margins.

Log what you pay for each ingredient once — pack price, pack size and unit — and Petrecipe works out the cost of every line, every batch and every serving. Open a recipe and its calculator tape prints a line for each ingredient as you add it, with a running total and a big per-serving figure at the bottom.

RECIPE COST CARDS
• Every recipe shows its cost per serving with a live meter
• Set a target cost per serving: the meter turns from herb green to tomato when a serving goes over
• Search by recipe or ingredient, filter by category or favourites, sort by cost or name

THE COST TAPE
• Add ingredients in g, kg, oz, lb, ml, l, tsp, tbsp, cup or each
• Automatic unit conversion — including weight ↔ volume using an ingredient's density, and pieces ↔ weight using its weight per piece
• Clear warnings when a line can't be costed yet, with a shortcut to fix it
• Portion scaling: cook for any number of servings and every quantity and cost scales
• Substitutions: price an alternative ingredient, see the cost difference per batch and per serving, and swap it into the total with one switch

PRICES & HISTORY
• Keep a price history for every ingredient, with the shop and date
• Unit price per kg, litre or piece, and the change since the previous price
• Price history charts for ingredients and cost history charts for recipes — tap to inspect any point

COMPARE
• Put two recipes side by side at the same number of portions
• See which is cheaper per serving and by how much, the priciest line in each, and the ingredients they share

REPORTS
• Average cost per serving, a ranking of every recipe against its target, category averages and the biggest price movers
• Saved calculations: freeze a costing as a receipt (great for quotes), then compare it with today's prices later
• Export a full PDF cost report, or CSV files of recipe costs and price history

YOUR DATA, ON YOUR IPHONE
• No account and no sign-in — Petrecipe opens straight into your recipes
• Works completely offline; nothing is collected or sent anywhere
• Full JSON backup and import (merge or replace), automatic daily recovery points, and clear-all with a safety copy
• Optional weekly price-check reminder (a local notification)

Also: categories with colours and icons, favourites, duplicate recipes, light and dark appearance, a currency of your choice, and haptics you can switch off.

Costs are estimates based on the prices and conversions you enter; kitchen volume measures use US cups and spoons.

name: Pinglove: Couples Widget
description:
Pinglove puts your favorite person on your home screen.

Pair with your partner or best friend using a private invite code. Send a photo, a drawing you made with your finger, or a short note, and it appears on their home-screen widget within minutes (instantly when the app is open).

WIDGETS
- Latest photo, drawing or note from your partner
- Days together counter
- Countdown to your next date, trip or birthday
- Your partner's mood emoji
- Optional distance apart (optional, shared only with your partner)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No public feed. Only the two of you see what you share.
- Report, block or unpair at any time.
- Delete your account and all your data inside the app.
- Photos are compressed so the app stays fast and light.

FREE
- 1 partner
- Photo, drawing and note widgets, days together, mood
- Last 7 days of history

PINGLOVE PRO
- Several friends or partners
- All widget styles: countdown and distance
- Full history
- Custom frames
- Your partner gets Pro too when you subscribe

Pricing: Monthly $2.99, Yearly $14.99 (3-day free trial), or Lifetime $24.99. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your store account settings. Prices may vary by country.

You must be 13 or older to use Pinglove.

Privacy policy: https://drahmedelmenshawy.github.io/pinglove-privacy/
Terms of use: https://drahmedelmenshawy.github.io/pinglove-privacy/terms

name: PSCIN
description: This app provides tools for organizing, tracking, and managing items and related information. Users can create entries, maintain detailed records, add optional images, organize content by category, and use search or scanning features to quickly retrieve information. It also supports status tracking and progress updates, offering a convenient way to manage and review stored information.

name: Radio Vocea Speranței
description:
Radio Vocea Speranței Moldova – o rază de SPERANȚĂ pentru TINE!

Ascultă Radio Vocea Speranței oriunde te afli: emisiunea în direct, programul zilei, emisiunile video, devoționalul zilnic și cursurile biblice, toate într-o singură aplicație simplă și gratuită.

RADIO ÎN DIRECT
• Pornești emisia live cu o singură atingere.
• Radioul continuă să cânte când ecranul este blocat sau folosești alte aplicații.
• Controlezi redarea din ecranul de blocare și din Centrul de control.
• Vezi mereu ce emisiune este acum în eter și ce urmează.

PROGRAMUL EMISIUNILOR
• Programul complet pentru fiecare zi a săptămânii.
• Emisiunea curentă este evidențiată, cu timpul rămas până la final.

EMISIUNI VIDEO
• Emisiunile postului, organizate pe categorii.
• Secțiune dedicată pentru Shorts.
• Căutare rapidă după titlu.

DEVOȚIONALUL ZILEI
• Un gând biblic nou în fiecare zi, cu versetul zilei.
• Se deschide instant, chiar și când conexiunea este slabă.

CURSURI BIBLICE
• Acces direct la cursurile gratuite ale Școlii Bibliei, chiar din aplicație.

ȘI MAI MULT
• Frecvențele FM din toată Republica Moldova.
• Datele de contact ale redacției și linkuri către rețelele noastre sociale.
• Resurse creștine recomandate.
• Temă deschisă sau întunecată, după preferință.

FĂRĂ CONT, FĂRĂ RECLAME
Aplicația nu îți cere înregistrare și nu conține publicitate. Nu colectăm date personale – detalii în politica de confidențialitate.

Radio Vocea Speranței este un post de radio creștin din Republica Moldova, cu emisiuni despre credință, familie, sănătate și muzică ce aduc speranță.

Ne poți scrie oricând la contact@rvs.md.

name: Real Estate Exam Ninja
description:
Pass your 2027 real estate licensing exam on the first try — completely free, with no account required, no subscriptions, and 100% offline study.

Updated for 2027, Real Estate Exam Ninja gives you everything you need for both the National (PSI & Pearson VUE) portion and your State-Specific Law portion in one fast, distraction-free app.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (100% FREE — ZERO PAYWALLS):
• 393 National Practice Questions across all 9 official exam domains (Property Ownership, Contracts & Leases, Financing & Mortgages, Valuation & Appraisal, Real Estate Math, Agency & Disclosures, Title/Deeds/Closing, Fair Housing & Federal Laws, and Land Use Controls).
• All 50 State-Specific Practice Exams (2,100+ statute-cited questions updated for 2027 and matched to each state's passing score).
• Study Mode & Timed Exam Mode: Get instant explanations after every answer in Study Mode, or simulate test day with a countdown timer, Flag for Review, and a full Question Navigator Grid.
• Topic Readiness Breakdown: Instantly see your weakest exam domains sorted first and drill any weak topic in one tap.
• 260 Interactive Exam Flashcards: Flip through 260 high-yield real estate terms and formulas across 10 topics with Reverse mode, Shuffle, Exam Tip memory hooks, and mastery tracking.
• Unlimited Real Estate Math & Live T-Bar Calculator: Practice freshly generated word problems across all 10 exam math topics (Commission, Seller's Net, IRV/Cap Rate, LTV, Points & Interest, Property Taxes/Mills, Prorations, Acreage & Sections, GRM, and Depreciation) with visual T-Bar hints, step-by-step worked solutions, and an interactive T-Bar Calculator.
• Question of the Day & Daily Streaks: Build a fast daily study habit right from your home screen.

ZERO DATA COLLECTED & 100% OFFLINE
No email sign-up, no login wall, and no tracking. Your state selection, streaks, missed questions, and flashcard progress stay strictly on your device — so you can study on a plane, commute, or anywhere without Wi-Fi.

Good luck on test day!

name: RunTrack - Traccia
description:
RunTrack è l'app per chi corre, cammina o pedala e vuole tenere traccia dei progressi senza account, senza pubblicità e senza cedere i propri dati.

REGISTRA CON IL GPS
• Percorso in tempo reale sulla mappa, anche a schermo spento
• Tempo, distanza, passo o velocità e dislivello
• Pausa e ripresa, e alla fine racconti com'è andata: sensazioni e note

APPLE WATCH E SALUTE
• Importa le corse registrate con Apple Watch, con percorso e frequenza cardiaca
• Scegli tu quali allenamenti importare
• Andamento della frequenza cardiaca a riposo

PERCORSO A COLORI
• Il tracciato si colora in base all'intensità, così vedi subito dove hai spinto di più

SEGMENTI E CLASSIFICHE
• Crea segmenti sui tuoi tratti preferiti: una salita, un rettilineo, il giro del parco
• RunTrack riconosce quando ci passi e mette in classifica i tuoi tempi

STATISTICHE
• Grafici interattivi su settimane e mesi: chilometri, tempo, passo e frequenza cardiaca
• Record personali e tendenze per capire come stai migliorando

PIANO DI ALLENAMENTO
• Piani per 5 km, 10 km, mezza maratona e maratona
• Scegli data della gara, livello e giorni di allenamento
• Le tue corse vengono abbinate da sole agli allenamenti previsti, con un diario settimanale
• Tempo previsto per la gara e una pagina che spiega come viene calcolato tutto

CONDIVIDI
• Immagine con mappa e dati della corsa
• Video 3D del percorso con il tuo personaggio personalizzabile
• Esporta in GPX o apri il percorso in Google Maps e Mappe

PRIVACY PRIMA DI TUTTO
• Nessun account, nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciamento
• Tutto resta sul tuo iPhone, con backup facoltativo in iCloud Drive

Disponibile in italiano, inglese, francese e tedesco. Tema chiaro e scuro, chilometri o miglia.

Il piano di allenamento è un'indicazione generale e non sostituisce il parere di un medico o di un allenatore.

name: Shirube: Clinic Visit Log
description:
A medical notebook for you and your family in Japan: clinic visits, medicines, lab values and medical costs in one place.

VISITS
- Log the clinic, department, date and amount paid
- Snap a Japanese receipt (領収書) and the amount, date and clinic are read on your iPhone
- Record train and bus fares to the clinic, one way or round trip
- Notes from the doctor, next appointment and a reminder the day before

MEDICINES
- Scan the お薬手帳 QR code (JAHIS format) from Japanese pharmacies
- See what is on record as current, based on dispensing date and days
- Add over-the-counter medicines by hand

LAB VALUES
- About 40 items such as HbA1c, LDL cholesterol and blood pressure, shown as charts
- Values are recorded as they are; the app never judges them

MEDICAL EXPENSE DEDUCTION (Japan)
- Yearly total minus insurance reimbursements
- How far you are from the 100,000 yen line (or 5% of income)
- Export a CSV laid out like the deduction statement (医療費控除の明細書)

VISIT MEMO
- Questions to ask, current medicines and recent lab values on one page

FAMILY
- Record up to 2 people for free

PRIVACY
- No account. Records stay on your iPhone
- iCloud sync is off by default and only uses your own iCloud
- Face ID lock and backup file export

SHIRUBE PRO (one purchase)
- 3 or more people
- PDF deduction statement
- PDF visit memo

Shirube is a record-keeping app. It does not diagnose or give medical advice. Deduction amounts are estimates; check your tax return with the National Tax Agency guidance.

name: Silk Spindle
description:
Step into a sunset workshop where threads hang from a lacquered spindle and every move ties a knot in your own story. Silk Spindle is a weaving puzzle with a Lunar New Year glow: plum blossoms, red lanterns, warm amber light.

Your route is simple. Swap two neighbouring threads. Matching threads of the same color and thickness twist into one thicker thread. Line them up well and one move sets off a chain of knots. Fill every order to finish the level. Let the row grow wider than the spindle and the braid slips.

New threads arrive from the sides. Watch the queue, count the dots, pull early or wait. Then the path gets wilder: dry threads to cut at the edge, pinned threads that hold their place, joker beads that join any color, fragile threads with a short fuse.

Every level is checked by a built-in solver before you see it. Finish near par for three stars. Stuck? Undo a move or ask for a hint. Fail a level twice and new threads arrive more slowly.

Each win curls the woven pattern into a 3D bracelet. Every bracelet records each move as a row of knots. Spin it with a finger, rename it, restyle it in cotton, silk or metal thread, and keep it in your Keepsake Box.

Explore further:
- An endless campaign that introduces one new thread at a time
- A Daily Pattern shared by every player, with a streak, a 30-day calendar and one forgiven miss per week
- My Patterns: turn any seed word into a new level, checked by the solver
- 12 achievements and leaderboards for levels, stars and streaks
- A Journal of 12 stories on rules, strategy and thread lore, from the red thread of fate to Inca knot records
- Tactile feedback and soft plucked notes that rise with every chain

Pick a thread. Make the swap. Follow the knots.

name: Söz Oýny: Turkmen Word Game
description:
Söz Oýny is a word puzzle game in the Turkmen language! Swipe the letters to build words, fill in the crossword and train your vocabulary. Read the meaning of every word you find in the built-in Turkmen dictionary. It starts easy and gets more exciting with every level.

HOW TO PLAY
- Connect the letters on the wheel to make a word.
- Every word you find drops into its place in the crossword.
- Find all the words to complete the level.
- Extra correct words that are not on the board earn bonus coins.

FEATURES
- 3000 levels, from short everyday words to long and tricky ones.
- Dictionary: meanings and examples for more than 6000 words, offline. "Meniň sözlügim" (My dictionary) collects every word you have found.
- Daily puzzle: a new big puzzle every day with extra coins. Keep your daily streak going!
- Weekly tournament: every word you find scores points, longer words score more. Compete with other players.
- Statistics and achievements: words found, longest word, daily streak and rewards.
- Play offline - on the road, in a queue, anywhere.
- Hints: reveal a letter, rocket, finger and more help on difficult words.
- Gifts, a magic chest and a lucky wheel. Watch a video to double your coins.
- Your progress is saved in Game Center - continue on a new iPhone.

TRAIN YOUR BRAIN
Word games grow your vocabulary and train attention and memory, and the dictionary teaches you the meaning of new words. A few minutes a day is enough. A great way for kids and adults to learn and practise Turkmen.

If you like crosswords, scrabble, word search, anagrams or logic games, Söz Oýny is made for you.

Questions or ideas? Write to us from the game menu: "Biz bilen habarlaşyň".

name: StrateGO: Korean Baduk
description:
Sit down at the board in a Joseon-era hanok. StrateGO is baduk, the Korean name of the game of Go, played under Korean rules against the computer or a friend, on ink-washed boards with original music inspired by Korean tradition.

PLAY THE KOREAN WAY
• Korean rules: territory counting (territory + captures + dead stones), komi 6.5, ko and suicide rules
• 9×9, 13×13 and 19×19 boards
• Play Black, White, or let nigiri decide
• Game clock with byoyomi, from 1 minute + 10 s × 3 up to 20 minutes + 30 s × 3, or no clock at all, with a spoken countdown in English or Korean

A COMPUTER OPPONENT FOR EVERY STRENGTH
• Nine levels, from Novice to Master
• A Monte Carlo tree search engine that runs entirely on your device
• Your wins and losses are recorded for every board size and level

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
• Three hints per game
• Undo
• Position estimate: see who owns each area of the board and who leads, by how many points
• Automatic dead-stone detection at the end of the game: tap a group to mark it dead or alive, then confirm the count
• The rules of Korean baduk in seven short points

NINE SCENES, NINE MELODIES
Every new game takes you to the next of nine ink paintings of Joseon Korea: the Dragon, the Stone Garden, the Full Moon, First Snow, Palace Rain, the Bamboo Grove, Misty Peaks, Spring Blossom and the Folding Screen. Each has its own original piece of music inspired by gugak, Korean traditional music. The stones are painted in ink on hanji paper.

• Two players on one device
• Your game is saved automatically: continue where you left off
• Plays offline on iPhone and iPad
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no tracking
• English and Korean

StrateGO is made by MP Software, www.mpsoftware.it

name: TilesDekho Dealer Hub
description:
TilesDekho Dealer Hub helps tile dealers and other tile businesses find buyer requirements and keep track of leads.

Browse listings to review the tile size, finish, quantity, budget, and location buyers have shared. Save relevant leads and, when contact details are available to your account, follow up by phone or WhatsApp. Buyers can post their tile requirements and manage their requests in the app.

Sign in with your mobile number to use your business account.

name: WinterServiceApp
description:
WinterServiceApp dokumentiert Ihren Winterdienst automatisch per GPS – als Leistungsnachweis für Auftraggeber, Hausverwaltungen und die eigene Abrechnung.

SO FUNKTIONIERT ES
• Legen Sie Ihre Einsatzorte als Zonen direkt auf der Karte an, z. B. Parkplätze, Gehwege oder Hofeinfahrten
• Passen Sie die Fläche jeder Zone Ecke für Ecke an
• Sobald Sie eine Zone befahren oder verlassen, schreibt die App automatisch einen Eintrag mit Datum und Uhrzeit ins Protokoll

LÄUFT AUCH IM HINTERGRUND
Die Aufzeichnung funktioniert auch bei gesperrtem Bildschirm, zum Beispiel wenn das iPhone während der Räumfahrt in der Halterung liegt. Dafür benötigt die App den Standortzugriff „Immer“.

LEISTUNGSNACHWEIS TEILEN
• Protokoll per Mail, Nachrichten oder AirDrop teilen oder in die Zwischenablage kopieren
• Zonen einzeln aktivieren oder deaktivieren

IHRE DATEN BLEIBEN BEI IHNEN
• Zonen und Protokolle werden ausschließlich lokal auf Ihrem iPhone gespeichert
• Kein Konto, keine Anmeldung, kein Tracking, keine Werbung

HINWEIS
Die dauerhafte Nutzung von GPS im Hintergrund erhöht den Akkuverbrauch. Für lange Einsätze empfiehlt sich eine Stromversorgung im Fahrzeug. Die Genauigkeit hängt vom GPS-Empfang ab.

name: Zasu: Tutoring Center Manager
description:
Zasu helps owners of tutoring centres, language schools and after-school classes run the whole centre from one app: enrolment, classes, tuition receipts, attendance and payroll.

SET UP YOUR CENTRE FROM SCRATCH
• Create a new centre in minutes; every centre's data is kept separate.
• Seven guided setup steps: centre profile, payment account, branches, staff, classes, students, fee templates.
• Import students and classes from Excel.

ENROLMENT & STUDENTS
• Track leads and trial lessons, then turn them into students.
• Student and parent profiles with class and fee history.

CLASSES & ATTENDANCE
• Classes, timetables and teachers for each branch.
• Teachers take attendance on their phone.

TUITION
• Fee templates per class and tuition receipts for each student.
• A list of students to remind about fees, plus revenue statistics.

STAFF & PAYROLL
• Teacher timesheets built from attendance.
• Pay by teaching hours, with allowances and bonuses.

ROLES
• Owner, academic manager, enrolment staff, advisors and teachers: everyone sees only their own work.

The app's interface is in Vietnamese.

Support: support@tinybee.ai

name: Zurc Check
description:
Zurc Check è lo strumento professionale per verificare il funzionamento di un iPhone prima di venderlo, acquistarlo o ripararlo.

Una procedura guidata ti porta attraverso tutti i controlli, uno dopo l'altro:
• Schermo tattile, multitouch, pixel e colori
• Fotocamere posteriori e frontale, flash
• Microfoni e altoparlanti, con verifica automatica
• Tasti laterali, tasto silenzioso e tasto fotocamera
• Vibrazione, sensori di movimento e di prossimità
• Face ID / Touch ID
• Carica con cavo, SIM e chiamata

Alla fine hai un riepilogo chiaro dei test superati e falliti e puoi assegnare il grado estetico del dispositivo.

Pensata per grossisti, negozi e laboratori: l'app funziona da sola e, insieme al programma Zurc Check per computer, permette di archiviare i test e stampare le etichette.

Disponibile in 11 lingue.

Privacy: l'app non salva e non invia foto, video o registrazioni audio e non raccoglie dati personali.

name: GTO Poker Trainer & Tools
description:
Play a hand. See every mistake. Get better.

GTO Poker Trainer is a No-Limit Hold'em training app that grades the decisions you make, not just whether you won the pot. Sit down at a 6-max table, play hands against computer opponents, and get a full review the moment each hand ends.

TRAIN
• 6-max No-Limit Hold'em against five opponent styles: tight-aggressive, loose-aggressive, nits, calling stations and maniacs
• Opponents act one at a time, like a real online table
• Live win probability and a list of the hands that beat you while you play
• Pick your seat, or rotate the button every hand

HAND REVIEW
• Every decision graded: Best, Good, Inaccuracy, Mistake or Blunder
• Preflop decisions checked against preflop charts
• Postflop decisions compared by estimated EV, so you can see what each option was worth
• Step through the hand street by street to see exactly where it went wrong

CHALLENGE MODE
• Can you double up before the clock runs out?
• 5, 10 or 30 minute challenges with blinds that rise every minute
• Aim to double, triple or quadruple your stack
• Easy, medium or hard opponents, with your challenge record tracked

TOOLS
• Preflop charts: 29 spots, including opening, facing a raise, limped and multiway pots, 3-bets and 4-bets
• Odds calculator: deal any hands and board for up to ten players; exact odds from the flop on
• Outs & pot odds trainer: count your outs, then decide if the call is worth the price
• Bankroll tracker: log your live cash games and tournaments, and see your hourly rate, ROI and results by casino and stakes, with CSV export

STATS
• Decision accuracy and streaks, tracked separately from wins and losses
• Accuracy over time, results by position, and a daily breakdown
• Hand history to replay any hand you've played

PLAY MONEY ONLY
GTO Poker Trainer is a training tool. It uses play money only: there are no deposits, no real-money games and nothing to win or cash out. It isn't gambling or financial advice. The bankroll tracker is a personal log for your own records and never handles money.

name: Presence Attendance
description:
Presence makes class attendance fast and fair. Instead of paper lists and roll calls, students mark their own attendance with a quick face check on their phone, during the class.

HOW IT WORKS
• Your school creates your account. Activate it once with your matriculation number, then set your email and password.
• Enroll your face one time. The app guides you through a short head turn so it can recognise you later.
• When a class is live, open Presence and tap Mark attendance. A quick face check confirms it is really you, and you are marked present.

FOR STUDENTS
• See today's classes and which ones are live right now
• Mark attendance in a few seconds
• Follow your attendance in every course, with your percentage
• Your timetable and the school calendar in one place
• Notifications from your class coordinator
• Works on slow connections: attendance is saved and sent when you are back online

FOR CLASS COORDINATORS
• Take care of your class: schedules, classrooms and attendance
• See who was present and export attendance reports

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The face check only confirms your identity for attendance
• No ads, and your data is never sold
• Data is encrypted between the app and the server

Presence is used by schools that have signed up. You need an account from your school to sign in. Lecturers and heads of department use the website at presenceapp.online.

Questions or help: support@presenceapp.online

name: upickup – Order Ready Alerts
description:
Stop waiting at the counter.

At cafés and restaurants that use PICK UP, scan the QR code on your receipt. Your order appears on your lock screen while it's being made, and your phone rings the moment it's ready. No account, no name, no phone number.

• See your order number and status live
• Your order on the lock screen and Dynamic Island: "Being prepared", then "Ready"
• A pager-style ring when it's ready, so you don't miss it
• Tap "On my way" so the café knows you're coming
• Loyalty stamp cards at participating cafés
• English and Arabic

You don't even need to download the app: scanning a PICK UP receipt opens it instantly as an App Clip. Want to see how it works? Tap "Try a demo order" inside the app.
